overview: Whether you're coding, posting, reviewing, or resolving, this release is packed with meaningful improvements that empower every user to work more efficiently — and bill with greater confidence.

items.title: Coding Scrubber
items.summary:
A new smart scrubber engine validates coding accuracy in real time using CMS and payer rules. Get flagged errors and suggestions before claims go out.

•	Built-in checks: PTP, MUE, CPT substitution, and ICD compatibility
•	Real-time feedback during claim save or review
•	Auto-correct or override with full visibility in logs

items.title: MMS Integration
items.summary: CommitMD now supports MMS as a new integration channel for transmitting and receiving healthcare data, including claims, remits, and eligibility responses. It offers a robust alternative to Inbox, using standardized messaging protocols for secure, real-time communication with clearinghouses and payers.

items: Blocked reuse of existing SSNs for patients or subscribers in Claim Bulk Upload Type 2.
Fixed an issue where multiple CPTs under the same serial weren’t displaying correctly in the encounter screen.
Resolved missing or misaligned CPT-level details in the Transaction Detailed BIRT Report.
Corrected logic that incorrectly generated a day record two days ahead during billing.
Fixed an issue where notes entered during quick payment posting were not retained.
Standardized email templates and fixed delivery issues for Contact Us and Request Demo forms.
System now correctly prompts for mandatory notes when adding a Debit Adjustment.
Removed invalid Void option for Unapply Refund transactions to prevent errors.
Resolved a UI overlap issue caused by expanded pagination settings.
Changed label from “System Notes” to “User Notes” for manually added notes.
Fixed a UI bug where the reset overlay didn’t fully mask the login form.
Corrected duplicate entries and missing unapplied lines during 835 parsing and ERA posting.
Enforced a 15-minute session timeout (10 min idle + 5 min warning) for improved security.
Resolved duplicate or misclassified adjustments for insurance, patient, and unapplied amounts.
Fixed missing CPT Status and ICN Number fields in the Denial Report output.
Only denied CPTs now follow the Bill to Patient path; approved CPTs continue standard flow.
Enhanced CPT list to show both paid and unpaid CPTs during 835 parsing.
Ensured charge values now reflect correctly in reports, even for unfocused claims.
Restricted 'SELF PAY' carriers to only use the 'SELF PAY' plan type.
Triggered an exception if a DOS in the bulk upload is missing carrier mapping.
Fixed gaps in 277 parsing to ensure parsing notes are always generated.
Resolved issue where payer names were not shown in the Payer Notes section.
Fixed rejection flow to ensure notes are created for all rejected visits.
Fixed issue were assigning a Responsible Party incorrectly updated account numbers.
Corrected calculation bugs that led to incorrect total balances in Inbox view.
Unified email layouts across environments (UAT, QA, Production) for consistent delivery.
Fixed a mismatch where the detailed view didn’t show accurate paid amounts.
